name: J3D_GetNumPaths
summary: Returns the number of paths (animated parts) in cut scene cut, loading the cut if needed.
semantics: Scene::LoadCutScene(cut) (loads the cut file by id on first use and keeps it in the cut cache; a later J3D_FreeCut frees it); answers the cut's part count, or 0 if the cut cannot be loaded.
notes: J3D natives live in the B3D dispatcher (indexes 144..167 AP, 146..169 FL).

name: J3D_GetPathBody
summary: Returns the body id that path path of cut scene cut animates, or 0 if the path has no body.
semantics: LoadCutScene(cut) (0 if not loadable); path must be 0 <= path < part count (else 0). If the part's flags have 0x40 (has body) answers part.bodyId, else 0.

name: J3D_GetPathCut
summary: Returns the sub-cut id that path path of cut scene cut plays, or 0 if the path is not a sub-cut.
semantics: As J3D_GetPathBody, but tests part flag 0x80 (has cut); the id is the same field (part.bodyId) holding a cut id.

name: J3D_GetPathSerial
summary: Returns the serial (part number) of path path of cut scene cut.
semantics: Same cut/index checks as J3D_GetPathBody (0 on failure); answers part.partNumber (the key the ...S variants of J3D_JobStart/JobPlay search by).

name: J3D_GetPathFather
summary: Returns the serial of the parent path of path path of cut scene cut.
semantics: Same checks; answers part.parentPartNumber (the part number of the parent in the cut's hierarchy; 0 on failure, so a root's value and failure may look the same).

name: J3D_GetPathFlags
summary: Returns the flag word of path path of cut scene cut (0x40 has body, 0x80 has sub-cut).
semantics: Same checks; answers part.flags.

name: J3D_GetPathPosAndRot
summary: Returns the world position and rotation of path path at its first (atEnd=0) or last key, placed relative to origin.
semantics: LoadCutScene(cut) and 0 <= path < count, else int 0. origin = {x, y, z, a, b, c} (position and three script angles; read with ArrayGetElement, no size check). M = rotation from origin angles; pos = origin position + (position key 0 or last) * M if the part has position keys; if it has rotation keys M = R(key 0 or last) * M. Answers a new 6-element array: pos x, y, z, then the Euler angles of M (written in the order c, a, b of the decomposition, as the original). Used by the stock AddObjectsFromCut with atEnd = 1.
fl: same, including the swapped key counters (FL 0x004b1661 position index from [part+8]-1, 0x004b16d8 rotation index from [part]-1)
x3_src: differs: fixed (bugs_fixed.md list: 'J3D_GetPathPosAndRot: end-of-path keys by their own counters', 6eee8d6) - the last position key uses the position count and the last rotation key the rotation count
bugs: AP 0x004953c8 / 0x00495407 (FL 0x004b1661 / 0x004b16d8): with atEnd != 0 the last position key index is taken from the rotation key count and the last rotation key index from the position key count: a path with more rotation keys than position keys (or the reverse) reads past a key array (garbage position/rotation or crash), otherwise a wrong key. x3_src fixed it (bugs_fixed.md, 6eee8d6). A short origin array dereferences a NULL element (crash), reproduced.

name: J3D_GetPathName
summary: Returns the name of path path of cut scene cut, or 0.
semantics: LoadCutScene(cut); 0 <= path < count; answers a copy of the part's name, or int 0 when the cut is not loadable, the index is out of range or the part has no name.

name: J3D_JobStart
returns: int completion code (4 finished, 5 stopped, 2 node freed, 3 camera released) | 11 finished at once | 0 failed
summary: Starts the path of cut scene cut whose body id is bodyId on scene node node and suspends the task until the job ends.
semantics: node = Scene::NodeFromHandle(node) (0 if invalid); LoadCutScene(cut) (0 if not loadable); the path is searched from the LAST part backwards by part.bodyId == bodyId (-1 -> 0). Scene::StampNodeSceneIds attaches the path to the node and starts it (0 on failure). If the node's animation flag 0x200 (ended) is already set the answer is 11 at once. Otherwise the node gets the 'notify' flag 0x40 and remembers the caller; the task WAITS (state 2, savegame return site) and is completed by the node's animation: 4 when the job reaches its end, 5 on J3D_JobStop, 2 when the node is freed, 3 when a camera node is released. The node keeps the animation state after completion.

name: J3D_JobStartS
summary: As J3D_JobStart, but selects the path by its serial (part number).
semantics: Same as J3D_JobStart; the search compares part.partNumber == serial (last match from the end). Waits until the job ends, with the same completion codes.

name: J3D_JobStop
summary: Ends the cut job on scene node node and releases the task waiting on it.
semantics: Scene::EndCutInstance on the node (invalid handle: nothing): if the job had not ended and a task waits on it (flag 0x40), that task is completed with 5 and the flag cleared; the node is marked ended (0x200). Answers 0.

name: J3D_JobGetRemainingTime
summary: Returns the remaining time (ms) of the cut job running on scene node node, 0 if none.
semantics: If the node runs a job (flag 1) that has not ended (no 0x200) and its cut is still loaded: remaining = clipEnd - elapsed (elapsed = last anim time - base time); unless flag 0x2000 is set, the path's own remaining animation length is used when it is smaller. Whole milliseconds. Otherwise (no node, no job, ended, cut freed) 0.

name: J3D_FindPath
summary: Returns 1 if cut scene cut has a path for body id bodyId.
semantics: LoadCutScene(cut) (0 if not loadable); Scene::FindCutSegmentIndexByKey searches part.bodyId == bodyId from the end; answers 1 if found, 0 otherwise (not the index).

name: J3D_LoadCut
summary: Loads cut scene cut into the cut cache (no-op if already loaded).
semantics: Scene::LoadCutScene(cut): finds the loaded cut by id or loads its file (cut ids map to cut file names, see B3D_GetCutFilename); answers 1 on success, 0 if it cannot be loaded. The cut stays loaded until J3D_FreeCut.

name: J3D_FreeCut
summary: Frees the loaded cut scene cut.
semantics: Scene::FindCutById(cut) (only an already loaded cut; nothing is loaded); if found, Scene::FreeCut releases it. Answers 0. Jobs on nodes that still reference the cut by id keep the id; J3D_JobGetRemainingTime then answers 0, and any later getter reloads it.
notes: What FreeCut does with nodes or takes still playing this cut was not read.

name: J3D_SetCutPos
summary: Sets the world position of the loaded cut scene cut (its paths play relative to it).
semantics: Scene::FindCutById(cut) (no load; not loaded -> nothing). cut.pos = (x, y, z) (script units); the next word is written with an unrelated stack value. If the cut's flag bit 0 is clear the part rotation is reset (identity) and the flag set, so the first SetCutPos also resets the orientation, later ones only move. Answers 0.
fl: same (FL does it in a helper, 0x004af240, mislabelled Math::VecLength in the FL database)

name: J3D_TakeAlloc
summary: Creates a new cut take (cut instance) and returns its id.
semantics: Scene::CreateCutInstance: allocates a take (a playback of a whole cut on a scene, with its own nodes); answers its id, 0 on failure. Owned by the scene system until J3D_TakeFree.

name: J3D_TakeStart
returns: int 1 when the take ends | 0 failed
summary: Plays cut scene cut as take take in scene scene (optionally through camera node camera) and suspends the task until the take ends.
semantics: argc must be 3 or 4 (else 0). argc 4: camera is resolved as an enabled camera node (0 if not). take = FindCutInstanceById, cut = LoadCutScene, scene = SceneFromHandle; any missing -> 0. Scene::RebindCutInstanceModel builds the take's nodes for the cut in the scene (with the camera) and starts it; failure -> 0. Success: the take remembers the caller; the task WAITS and is completed with 1 when the take finishes (end of the cut, or J3D_TakeStop).
notes: Whether J3D_TakeFree of a running take completes the waiting task was not read.

name: J3D_TakeStop
summary: Finishes the running take take; its waiting J3D_TakeStart task gets 1.
semantics: Scene::FindCutInstanceById(take); if found Scene::FinishCutInstance: ends the jobs of its nodes (J3D_JobStop semantics on each, waiting job tasks get 5), completes the task waiting on the take with 1 and clears it, and sets the take back to ready. Answers 0.

name: J3D_TakeFree
summary: Destroys take take and its nodes.
semantics: Scene::FindCutInstanceById(take); if found Scene::DestroyCutInstance frees the take and the nodes it built. Answers 0. The id is invalid afterwards.

name: J3D_JobPlay
returns: int completion code (4 finished, 5 stopped, 2 node freed, 3 camera released) | 11 | 0
summary: Plays the time range start..end (ms) of the path for body id bodyId of cut scene cut on node node and suspends the task until it ends.
semantics: Node, cut and path (by part.bodyId, last match) as J3D_JobStart; 0 if any is missing. Scene::StartNodeAnimation(start, path, node, cut, end, clamp=0): end < 1 means the path's whole animation length; if start >= 1, end >= 0 and start > end the range plays backwards (flag 0x8000); the node's anim base time is set from the game time. Then as J3D_JobStart: 11 at once if the node is already marked ended, else the task WAITS for the completion code (4 at the end, 5 J3D_JobStop, 2 node freed, 3 camera released).

name: J3D_JobPlayS
summary: As J3D_JobPlay, but selects the path by its serial (part number).
semantics: Same as J3D_JobPlay with the path searched by part.partNumber == serial. Waits until the job ends.

name: J3D_JobPlayAsync
returns: int 1 started | 11 ended at once | 0 failed
summary: Starts the time range start..end of a path of cut scene cut on node node and returns at once (no wait). Intended to search by body id, but searches by serial (bug).
semantics: As J3D_JobPlay but no completion is registered: answers 1 after a successful start (11 if the node is already marked ended), 0 on failure. Intended: key = body id (the non-S variant). Actual: the selection compares the command number with J3D_JobPlay's (CMP EBX,0xa4), a number that never reaches this branch, so it ALWAYS searches by part.partNumber (serial) - J3D_JobPlayAsync behaves exactly like J3D_JobPlayAsyncS. Pass a serial.
fl: same (the same compare against FL's JobPlay number 0xa6 at 0x004b1997)
bugs: AP 0x00495705 CMP EBX,0xa4 (FL 0x004b1997 CMP ESI,0xa6): the non-S variant searches by serial instead of body id, so a body id key finds no path (answer 0) or plays another path. Stock scripts call only the S variant; mods are affected. x3_src reproduces it on purpose (b3d_native_dispatcher.cpp comment 'Preserve the legacy JobPlay comparison'); listed in bugs.md (open).

name: J3D_JobPlayAsyncS
summary: Starts the time range start..end of the path with serial serial of cut scene cut on node node and returns at once.
semantics: As J3D_JobPlay (path by part.partNumber == serial, range rules of StartNodeAnimation) but without waiting: answers 1 after a successful start, 11 if the node is already marked ended, 0 on failure. Use J3D_JobGetRemainingTime to poll.
